mods.name: TreeFell
mods.description: Rompi un blocco di tronco e l'intero albero (solo legno) viene abbattuto all'istante.

releases.notes:
- Target: Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3, Fabric API 0.152.2+26.2
- Initial release
- Hooks into PlayerBlockBreakEvents.AFTER (Fabric API), server-side only
- BFS traversal (3x3x3 neighbor search) across connected log blocks using the minecraft:logs tag
- Breaks all connected logs via destroyBlock(pos, true), preserving normal drops (Fortune/Silk Touch respected)
- Hard cap of 512 logs per tree-fell operation to prevent lag/abuse on large structures
- Leaves are untouched and decay naturally per vanilla rules
- No mixins, no client-side code

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheMars853/TreeFeller/commits/1.0.0+26.2

readmeSummary: Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2: break a single log block and the entire tree (wood only — leaves stay and decay normally) is felled instantly.
